title: Where a represented current vanishes on an open set, its weight θH^n⌞M vanishes (fundamental lemma)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, W ⊆ ℝ^P, let T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n. Suppose W is open, W ⊆ U, and T vanishes on W (T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω ⊆ W). Then R.measure(W) = 0, where R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → R.measure W = 0
